newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill sees Polish bank stocks stable this year.
newsitem.headline: Merrill sees Polish bank stocks stable this year.

text.p: Polish banking stocks should remain stable this year after already having risen around 130 percent in 1996, Merrill Lynch said in a report.
It said banks' price-earnings ratios had settled between 5.1 and 8.3 times this year's earnings estimates.
"We expect prices to remain around these levels through the end of the year and hence are neutral on the sector in the intermediate term," the report dated August 27 said.
But Merrill said it remained very bullish on Polish banks in the longer term, with sector assets seen up 12 percent annually over the next five years and earnings up eight percent.
Merrill said Bank Slaski and BRE were most likely to see long-term growth, with the leading Polish banks seen sustaining real earnings growth of 10 to 15 percent over the next five years.
